description: Provision a Google Cloud Privateca PrivateCACertificate via Config Connector. Fields mirror the privateca.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 PrivateCACertificate spec.

caPoolRef.description: Immutable. Required. The PrivateCACAPool that includes this Certificate. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed PrivateCACAPool resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/caPools/{{caPoolID}}".

name.description: The name of a PrivateCACAPool resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a PrivateCACAPool resource.

certificateAuthorityRef.description: Immutable. Optional. The PrivateCACertificateAuthority that issued this Certificate. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed PrivateCACertificateAuthority resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/caPools/{{caPool}}/certificateAuthorities/{{certificateAuthorityID}}".

name.description: The name of a PrivateCACertificateAuthority resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a PrivateCACertificateAuthority resource.

certificateTemplateRef.description: Immutable. Optional. The PrivateCACertificateTemplate used to issue this Certificate. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed PrivateCACertificateTemplate resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/certificateTemplates/{{certificateTemplateID}}".

name.description: The name of a PrivateCACertificateTemplate resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a PrivateCACertificateTemplate resource.

config.description: Immutable. Optional. A description of the certificate and key that does not require X.509 or ASN.1.

publicKey.description: Immutable. Optional. The public key that corresponds to this config.

format.description: Immutable. Required. The format of the public key. Possible values: KEY_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED, PEM

key.description: Immutable. Required. A public key. The padding and encoding must match with the `KeyFormat` value specified for the `format` field.

subjectConfig.description: Immutable. Required. Specifies some of the values in a certificate that are related to the subject.

subject.description: Immutable. Required. Contains distinguished name fields such as the common name, location and organization.

countryCode.description: The country code of the subject.

locality.description: The locality or city of the subject.

postalCode.description: The postal code of the subject.

province.description: The province, territory, or regional state of the subject.

streetAddress.description: The street address of the subject.

subjectAltName.description: Immutable. Optional. The subject alternative name fields.

dnsNames.description: Immutable. Optional. Contains only valid, fully-qualified host names.

emailAddresses.description: Immutable. Optional. Contains only valid RFC 2822 E-mail addresses.

ipAddresses.description: Immutable. Optional. Contains only valid 32-bit IPv4 addresses or RFC 4291 IPv6 addresses.

uris.description: Immutable. Optional. Contains only valid RFC 3986 URIs.

x509Config.description: Immutable. Required. Describes how some of the technical X.509 fields in a certificate should be populated.

additionalExtensions.description: Immutable. Optional. Describes custom X.509 extensions.

critical.description: Immutable. Optional. Indicates whether or not this extension is critical.

objectId.description: Immutable. Required. The OID for this X.509 extension.

objectIdPath.description: Immutable. Required. The parts of an OID path. The most significant parts of the path come first.

value.description: Immutable. Required. The value of this X.509 extension.

aiaOcspServers.description: Immutable. Optional. Describes Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP) endpoint addresses that appear in the "Authority Information Access" extension in the certificate.

caOptions.description: Immutable. Optional. Describes options in this X509Parameters that are relevant in a CA certificate.

isCa.description: Immutable. Optional. When true, the "CA" in Basic Constraints extension will be set to true.

maxIssuerPathLength.description: Immutable. Optional. Refers to the "path length constraint" in Basic Constraints extension.

nonCa.description: Immutable. Optional. When true, the "CA" in Basic Constraints extension will be set to false. If both `is_ca` and `non_ca` are unset, the extension will be omitted from the CA certificate.

zeroMaxIssuerPathLength.description: Immutable. Optional. When true, the "path length constraint" in Basic Constraints extension will be set to 0. if both max_issuer_path_length and zero_max_issuer_path_length are unset, the max path length will be omitted from the CA certificate.

keyUsage.description: Immutable. Optional. Indicates the intended use for keys that correspond to a certificate.

baseKeyUsage.description: Immutable. Optional. Describes high-level ways in which a key may be used.

certSign.description: Immutable. Optional. The key may be used to sign certificates.

contentCommitment.description: Immutable. Optional. The key may be used for cryptographic commitments. Note that this may also be referred to as "non-repudiation".

crlSign.description: Immutable. Optional. The key may be used sign certificate revocation lists.

dataEncipherment.description: Immutable. Optional. The key may be used to encipher data.

decipherOnly.description: Immutable. Optional. The key may be used to decipher only.

digitalSignature.description: Immutable. Optional. The key may be used for digital signatures.

encipherOnly.description: Immutable. Optional. The key may be used to encipher only.

keyAgreement.description: Immutable. Optional. The key may be used in a key agreement protocol.

keyEncipherment.description: Immutable. Optional. The key may be used to encipher other keys.

extendedKeyUsage.description: Immutable. Optional. Detailed scenarios in which a key may be used.

clientAuth.description: Immutable. Optional. Corresponds to OID 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.2. Officially described as "TLS WWW client authentication", though regularly used for non-WWW TLS.

codeSigning.description: Immutable. Optional. Corresponds to OID 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.3. Officially described as "Signing of downloadable executable code client authentication".

emailProtection.description: Immutable. Optional. Corresponds to OID 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.4. Officially described as "Email protection".

ocspSigning.description: Immutable. Optional. Corresponds to OID 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.9. Officially described as "Signing OCSP responses".

serverAuth.description: Immutable. Optional. Corresponds to OID 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.1. Officially described as "TLS WWW server authentication", though regularly used for non-WWW TLS.

timeStamping.description: Immutable. Optional. Corresponds to OID 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.8. Officially described as "Binding the hash of an object to a time".

unknownExtendedKeyUsages.description: Immutable. Optional. Used to describe extended key usages that are not listed in the KeyUsage.ExtendedKeyUsageOptions message.

objectIdPath.description: Immutable. Required. The parts of an OID path. The most significant parts of the path come first.

policyIds.description: Immutable. Optional. Describes the X.509 certificate policy object identifiers, per https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5280#section-4.2.1.4.

objectIdPath.description: Immutable. Required. The parts of an OID path. The most significant parts of the path come first.

lifetime.description: Immutable. Required. The desired lifetime of a certificate. Used to create the "not_before_time" and "not_after_time" fields inside an X.509 certificate.

location.description: Immutable. The location for the resource.

pemCsr.description: Immutable. Optional. A pem-encoded X.509 certificate signing request (CSR).

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: Immutable. Required. The Project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

subjectMode.description: Immutable. Optional. Specifies how the Certificate's identity fields are to be decided.

title: GCP Privateca PrivateCACertificate
